scope: isolated Iran-France test environment; no customer route or VPN configuration changed

engines.name: TwinTunnel two-ended UDP multiplexer over separate Rakhsh GRE and Shabdiz-UDP lab carriers
recent_features: at most two retries after initial send
pending queues capped at 256 per flow

origin_france_before_retries.note: France-host hairpin ingress, not representative of independent real Iranian client

origin_iran_before_retries.note: All upstream packets reached the French echo; remaining measured loss was on return to Iran

origin_iran_with_downstream_ack.note: Zero measured loss is limited to these short echo tests; retry may add latency/traffic and does not prove VPN application delivery

downstream_ack_only_trial.limitation: Fault injection not reliably overlapped timed data; treat as baseline failure observation.

bidirectional_ack_timed_gre_failure.interpretation: Tunnel overlay delivered/authenticated all 92 encrypted UDP datagrams to the local forwarding socket, but one of 80 IP packets was absent from OpenVPN server TUN; full end-to-end reliability not achieved.

not_yet_production_ready: One OpenVPN UDP IP packet still missing in controlled 80-packet fault test
GRE and Shabdiz-UDP share the same underlying Iran-France endpoints
Need substantial sustained real-client load and real independent host/route failover
Engine limited to 64 flows and lacks dynamic quota/device/session/license integration
No validated NAT rebinding, MTU discovery or high-scale flow migration
